accepted (try B): the ditch between him and the right-hand fence, a notch about 40% down the cut face; both footings kept; the mower and its dock are gone (put back before loop 4)
accepted (try A): a black pipe along the bottom of the ditch, its round end in the cut face
rejected (try A): the whole front cut face turned into a concrete wall and the ditch filled in

accepted (try B, not forced further): a smooth concrete wall lines the ditch on the T-rex's side (not the fence side) and the ditch runs deeper at the front, the drain at its bottom; reads as a walled moat
rejected (try A): the ditch filled in with lawn from above (the cut face kept its channel)
accepted (try B): the ditch open with its wall, the far slope turfed green
accepted (try A): he faces the camera in the middle of the lawn, tail to the back left; the shed a heap of planks; fence, ditch and ring intact
rejected (try A): two hollows; the picket ring and the front-left poles (with the left footing) removed
accepted (try B, not forced further): one round hollow in front of him; the front of the picket ring and a few front-left poles gone; no bowl in the cut face
accepted (try A): the hollow lined smooth grey, a basin; all else held
accepted (try A): a ring of big grey boulders round the hollow
accepted (try A): the wallow full of cyan water, his head down in it; the light a little warmer and darker (colour shift in the edit)
accepted (try A): upright, facing the camera, the robot mower crunched in his jaws, dripping
accepted (try A): a long concrete slab under him running back toward the back right; the back of the picket ring now under it
rejected (try A): a huge walled box; the T-rex inside shrank by about a third
accepted (try B): corrugated walls close round him, chest-high; he stands in the front doorway, his size and pose kept
accepted (try A): a corrugated roof over the building and his back; his head and the mower out over the front doorway
used (try A, after try B came back the same): door shut, mower mowing; the building smaller and further back than S4_3 (W4_4 has to absorb it); the wallow unchanged
not used (try B): the same smaller building, and the wallow enlarged
accepted (try A): the front opening cut, the panel flat on the grass, his face inside
rejected (try A): framed the wallow and the cut face instead of the opening in the building
accepted (try B): a steel frame round the building's opening (subtle); wallow and cut face unchanged
accepted (try A): a thick glass slab in the frame, his face behind it
accepted (try A): a red round bed in front of the glass, the dog in it nose to nose with the T-rex; readable from the stage view
accepted (try A): a low close view, the dog in his red bed nose to nose with the T-rex through the thick glass; both match their keys
both asleep against the glass (try A)
